itineraries.title: Downtown Raleigh Friday: Ocean Feeding, Historic Oakwood Tour, Gallery C, Tree Lighting at Moore Square, Lace Museum
itineraries.theme: A walkable downtown day of museums and history that ends at the 18th annual Raleigh Tree Lighting in Moore Square
itineraries.drive_time: Everything is in downtown Raleigh within about 1 mi of Moore Square (straight line). From elsewhere in the Triangle, plan on 20-40 min to downtown (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Events free except the Oakwood tour ($15) and the Lace Museum ($5 adult); about $45-$70 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Friday is mostly sunny with a high near 70°F. Have avocado toast at A Place at the Table, catch the 10:45 AM ocean-habitat feeding at the NC Museum of Natural Sciences, and eat Lebanese mezze at Sitti. Walk Historic Oakwood with Triangle Walking Tours at 1 PM, then see Bert Sult's Venice watercolors at Gallery C on North Blount. Dinner is Lao food at Bida Manda, right on Moore Square, before the tree lighting and holiday market (5:30-8 PM). The Raleigh Lace Museum is open 6-9 PM two blocks away.

morning.title: Live Animal Feeding: Ocean Habitat
morning.location: NC Museum of Natural Sciences, 11 W. Jones St., Raleigh, NC 27601
morning.notes: 15-minute feeding of the 10,000-gallon Our Changing Oceans aquarium with Living Collections staff. Info: https://www.visitraleigh.com/event/live-animal-feeding%3a-ocean-habitat/104138/

afternoon.title: Historic Oakwood and N. Blount Tour
afternoon.location: Heck-Andrews House, 309 N. Blount St., Raleigh, NC 27601
afternoon.notes: Guided walk through Oakwood's Victorian architecture with Triangle Walking Tours. Book: https://www.trianglewalkingtours.com/booking-calendar/historic-oakwood-and-n-blount-tour-1?referral=service_list_widget

afternoon.title: Venice: New Paintings by Bert Sult
afternoon.location: Gallery C, 540 N. Blount St., Raleigh, NC 27604
afternoon.notes: Listed 11 AM-4:30 PM. Watercolors by North Carolina architect and painter Bert Sult. About 0.4 mi north of the Heck-Andrews House. Info: https://raleighmag.com/event/venice-new-paintings-by-bert-sult/2026-11-20/

evening.title: 18th Annual Raleigh Tree Lighting
evening.location: Moore Square, 200 S Blount St, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: 5:30-8 PM. Tree lighting, holiday market, free photos with Santa and live performances. Info: https://downtownraleigh.org/do/18th-annual-downtown-raleigh-tree-lighting

evening.title: First Fridays at the Raleigh Lace Museum
evening.location: Kristin S. Conrad Lace Center & Raleigh Lace Museum, 133 Fayetteville St., Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: Open 6-9 PM. About 0.4 mi west of Moore Square. Info: https://www.visitraleigh.com/event/first-fridays-at-the-raleigh-lace-museum/110137/

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast (VG): mashed avocado salad, tomato, fried eggs, feta and cilantro on multigrain
food.notes: 300 W. Hargett St. Suite 50, Raleigh, NC 27601. Own site: Tuesday-Sunday 8 AM-2 PM, closed Monday. A pay-what-you-can community café. Own menu marks (VG) = vegetarian: Avocado Toast $13, Soup of the Day $10. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Warak Anab: grape leaves stuffed with rice and vegetables in pomegranate molasses (labeled gluten-free, vegan)
food.vegetarian_dish: Fried Cauliflower: za'atar, cilantro, tomato, goat cheese, spicy tahini labneh (labeled vegetarian, $14.95)
food.notes: 135 S. Wilmington Street, Raleigh, NC 27601. Own contact page: Sunday-Thursday 11 AM-9 PM, Friday-Saturday 11 AM-10 PM; closed Thanksgiving Day. Own lunch menu labels: Falafel $7.95 (gluten-free, vegan), Warak Anab $9.95 (gluten-free, vegan), Lentil & Kale Soup $4.95/$6.95 (vegan), Cheese Rolls $15.95 (vegetarian).

food.vegan_dish: Manda's Herb Salad with fried tofu (marked vegan): lettuce, bean sprouts, herbs, cucumber, pickled carrot and daikon, peanuts, caramelized sweet chili sauce
food.vegetarian_dish: Manda Amphone's Curry with pumpkin (GF/V): slow-cooked coconut curry with root vegetables and jasmine rice
food.notes: 222 South Blount Street, Raleigh, NC 27601, on Moore Square. Own contact page: Monday-Saturday 5-10 PM, Sunday 5-9 PM; parking in the Moore Square deck (entrance on Wilmington Street). Own menu key: V = vegetarian. Manda Amphone's Curry with pumpkin (GF/V) $25.90; Crispy Rice Lettuce Wraps (GF/V, contain egg) $17.90; Manda's Herb Salad with fried tofu (marked vegan) $26.90. Book ahead on a tree-lighting night.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly sunny and near 70°F; good walking weather.
alternatives.rain: The NC Museum of Natural Sciences (11 W. Jones St.) is free and indoors; its 1:30 PM 'Incredible Science' program is listed free (event 4bc787e290b3).

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly sunny day; cooler after dark, so bring a layer.
alternatives.rain: If you would rather stay indoors after dinner, the Lace Museum (6-9 PM) and the Tree Lighting After Party at Element Gastropub, 421 Fayetteville St, from 8 PM (price not listed; event 458a9dbb7547) are both close by.

practical_notes: Suggested arrival downtown: 8:30 AM for breakfast at A Place at the Table; it is about 0.4 mi from the Museum of Natural Sciences.
Bida Manda's site lists the Moore Square parking deck (entrance on Wilmington Street) and two-hour meters on Blount Street; it says street parking is free after 6 PM on weeknights.
A free 30-minute Moore Square history walk starts at the Moore Square Visitor Center at 11 AM (event 1f1c3d426e1e) if you skip the ocean feeding.
Tree-lighting booking/info page: https://downtownraleigh.org/dra-programs/tree-lighting
All stops are walkable; the farthest leg is Gallery C to Bida Manda, about 1 mi (straight line).

itineraries.title: Raleigh Christmas Parade Day: Parade, Lunch with Santa at Gravy, North Hills Tree Lighting, NC Symphony Beethoven
itineraries.theme: The 82nd Raleigh Christmas Parade, Santa at lunch, a second tree lighting at North Hills and an evening at the symphony
itineraries.drive_time: Downtown Raleigh to North Hills is about 4 mi (straight line), roughly 15-20 min by car; North Hills back to the Martin Marietta Center is about 4.6 mi (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).

weather.summary: Partly Sunny; chance of light rain at night

itineraries.cost_range: Parade and tree lighting free; symphony $22-$80; about $55-$95 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Saturday is partly sunny with a high near 67°F and a chance of light rain after dark (low near 51°F). Grab breakfast at The Morning Times on Hargett Street, then stake out a spot on Fayetteville Street for the 9:30 AM Raleigh Christmas Parade. Santa visits Gravy and Sitti from noon to 2 PM after the parade. Drive to North Hills for its tree lighting (4-7 PM), have dinner at Irregardless, and finish with Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 by the North Carolina Symphony at 8 PM.

morning.title: 82nd Annual ABC11 Crossroads Ford Raleigh Christmas Parade presented by Shop Local Raleigh
morning.location: Hillsborough St at St. Mary's St to Fayetteville St at Lenoir St, downtown Raleigh
morning.notes: About 1.4 miles and about 2.5 hours. The route passes the State Capitol and ends on Fayetteville Street. Info: https://shoplocalraleigh.org/events/raleigh-1/family-friendly-2/82nd-abc11-raleigh-christmas-parade-presented-by-shop-local-raleigh/

afternoon.title: Lunch with Santa (Santa's Post Parade Party)
afternoon.location: Gravy, 135 S. Wilmington Street, Raleigh, NC 27601
afternoon.notes: Sitti's own page: Santa visits Sitti and its neighbor Gravy 12-2 PM after the parade; make a lunch reservation at either restaurant. https://www.sitti-raleigh.com/happenings/lunch-with-santa

afternoon.title: Christmas Tree Lighting Celebration
afternoon.location: North Hills, 4321 Lassiter at North Hills Ave, Raleigh, NC 27609
afternoon.notes: 4-7 PM. Live entertainment, kids' crafts, a vendor village and Santa's arrival. Info: https://www.visitnorthhills.com/events/tree-lighting-celebration-8r6hb-zp3yk

evening.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 with the North Carolina Symphony
evening.location: Meymandi Concert Hall, Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts, 2 E South St, Raleigh, NC 27601
evening.notes: 8-9:45 PM. Carlos Miguel Prieto conducts; Alessio Bax, piano. Program: Gabriela Ortiz's Tzam, Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1, Shostakovich's Symphony No. 6. Tickets: https://ncsymphony.org/27cl05-NCS-Beethoven-piano-1

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast: multigrain bread with diced potatoes, house guacamole, tomato and cotija
food.notes: 10 E. Hargett Street, Raleigh, NC 27601, half a block off Fayetteville Street. Own site: open daily 7 AM-6 PM, kitchen closes 5 PM; closed Thanksgiving Day. Own menu (not labeled vegetarian): Avocado Toast $7.50, Breakfast Burrito $11.25 (eggs, cotija, black beans, roasted jalapeño, salsa, sour cream). Vegetarian by listed ingredients. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Sorbet, current selection (labeled dairy-free, gluten-free, vegan); no vegan main verified
food.vegetarian_dish: Risotto Balls: saffron risotto filled with fontina and herbs, fried, over house gravy (labeled vegetarian)
food.notes: 135 S. Wilmington Street, Raleigh, NC 27601 (next door to Sitti). Hosts Santa 12-2 PM on parade day; reserve ahead. Own site: closed Thanksgiving Day. Own lunch menu labels: Risotto Balls $12.50 (vegetarian), Traditional Bruschetta $12.50 (vegetarian), Zuppa $8 (vegetarian), Sorbet $7.50 (dairy-free, gluten-free, vegan).

food.vegan_dish: Chilled Sesame Noodles: pickled vegetables, crushed peanuts, spicy chili crisp (labeled vegan)
food.vegetarian_dish: Tempura Oyster Mushroom: yuzu aioli, chili crunch (labeled gluten-free, vegetarian)
food.notes: 901 W Morgan St, Raleigh, NC 27603, about 1 mi from the Martin Marietta Center. Own site: dinner Friday-Saturday 4:30-10 PM. Own dinner menu: Chilled Sesame Noodles $14 (vegan), Tempura Oyster Mushroom $14 (gluten-free, vegetarian), 'Not Chos' with cashew queso and vegan chorizo (gluten-free, vegan).

alternatives.good_weather: Partly sunny and mild by late morning; the parade draws large crowds, so arrive early.
alternatives.rain: For a seat indoors, Taverna Agora hosts an Annual Christmas Parade Watch Party 7:30-10:45 AM, $30 adults / $15 kids 12 and under (event 0dbecc602f8c).

alternatives.good_weather: Partly sunny through the afternoon; light rain chances rise after dark.
alternatives.rain: Skip North Hills and see Carolina Ballet's Jewels at 2 PM at Raleigh Memorial Auditorium, next to Meymandi Hall (price not in the store; event e92cfd529df5).

practical_notes: Leave early: plan to park downtown by about 8 AM. Sitti's contact page lists the Wilmington Street Station, Moore Square and Municipal Building decks (2 hours free) plus the City Center/Red Hat deck at 429 S. Wilmington Street. Parade-day street closures were not checked.
The parade disbands on Fayetteville Street at Lenoir Street, a few blocks south of Gravy.
Drive to North Hills around 3:30 PM; parking there was not verified.
Leave North Hills by about 5:45 PM for a 6:15 PM dinner at Irregardless, then about 1 mi to the concert hall.
The parade's organizer page: https://grma.org/christmas-parade/

itineraries.title: Cary Lights Saturday: Farmers Market, Fenton Holiday Market, Light the Square, NC Chinese Lantern Festival Opening Night
itineraries.theme: Holiday shopping and two light shows in Cary, ending at the first night of the 11th NC Chinese Lantern Festival
itineraries.drive_time: Downtown Cary is about 8 mi (straight line) west of downtown Raleigh, roughly 20-25 min by car. Fenton is about 1.4 mi from Koka Booth Amphitheatre (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).

weather.summary: Partly Sunny; chance of light rain at night

itineraries.cost_range: Markets and Light the Square free; lantern festival tickets not in the store (see the Koka Booth page); about $45-$80 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Saturday is partly sunny with a high near 67°F; after dark it turns mostly cloudy with a chance of light rain and a low near 51°F. Start at La Farm Bakery in downtown Cary and the Cary Farmers Market at Downtown Cary Park. At Fenton, browse the Triangle Pop Up Handcrafted Holiday Market, have dim sum at Brewery Bhavana, and stay for Light the Square (3-7 PM). Eat early at SAAP on South Walker Street, then go to opening night of the NC Chinese Lantern Festival at Koka Booth Amphitheatre (6-10 PM).

morning.title: Cary Farmers Market
morning.location: Downtown Cary Park, 327 S. Academy St., Cary, NC 27511
morning.notes: 9 AM-noon. Locally made and locally grown vendors. Info: https://downtowncarypark.com/things-to-do/calendar/w_cary-farmers-market-121

morning.title: Triangle Pop Up – Handcrafted Holiday Market
morning.location: Fenton Square, 21 Fenton Main St., Cary, NC 27511
morning.notes: 11 AM-4 PM on Main Street at Fenton. Info: https://fentonnc.com/event/triangle-pop-up-handcrafted-holiday-market-3/

afternoon.title: Light the Square 2026
afternoon.location: Fenton Square, 201 Fenton Gateway Dr, Cary, NC 27511
afternoon.notes: 3-7 PM. Fenton's annual tree lighting with a Christmas market of local vendors. Info: https://fentonnc.com/event/light-the-square/

evening.title: 2026 NC Chinese Lantern Festival (opening night)
evening.location: Koka Booth Amphitheatre, 8003 Regency Parkway, Cary, NC 27518
evening.notes: Runs Nov 21, 2026-Jan 10, 2027. Koka Booth's page: open daily 6-10 PM; evening-session tickets are 6-9 PM entry; prices rise if bought the day you attend; children 2 and under free. Tickets: https://www.boothamphitheatre.com/nc-chinese-lantern-festival/

food.vegetarian_dish: Spinach Feta Quiche: sautéed spinach, feta, onion, eggs and cream in a flaky crust, with fruit
food.notes: 220 W. Chatham St., Cary, NC 27511. Own breakfast page: breakfast served 8-11 AM Monday-Saturday; prices are not shown on that page. Vegetarian by listed ingredients (not labeled): Tomato Cheddar Scramble, Spinach Feta Quiche. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Bamboo Shoot Salad: tofu skin and bamboo shoots in house chili oil (marked vegan, gluten-free)
food.vegetarian_dish: Vegetable Curry Puff: baked pastries filled with curried cauliflower, spinach and sweet potato (marked vegetarian)
food.notes: 850 Lower Garden Lane, Cary, NC 27511, at Fenton. Own location page: Saturday 11:30 AM-11 PM. Own Fenton menu: Bamboo Shoot Salad $15.80 (vegan, gluten-free), Vegetable Curry Puff $16.80 (vegetarian), Siji Dou green beans $12.80 (vegan).

food.vegan_dish: Vegan Pho Lao: five-spice vegetable broth, black mushroom, tofu, rice noodles
food.vegetarian_dish: Summer Rolls, vegetable (V): vermicelli, herbs and vegetables in rice paper with hoisin peanut sauce
food.notes: 370 South Walker Street, Cary, NC 27511, about 2 mi from Koka Booth Amphitheatre. Own site: Saturday 11:30 AM-2 PM and 4:30-9:30 PM. Own menu: Vegan Pho Lao $23 (five-spice vegetable broth, black mushroom, tofu, rice noodles); Summer Rolls with vegetables (V) $17.

alternatives.leg: Fenton markets and Light the Square (outdoor)
alternatives.rain: Fenton has indoor shops and Brewery Bhavana's glass dining room. The Cary Theater, 122 E. Chatham St., screens 'Fjord' at 5 PM (price not in the store; event 4f1fd9d73edd).

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly cloudy with a low near 51°F; dress warmly.
alternatives.rain: Light rain is possible. Koka Booth links a Weather Policy page from its site; check it before you go. An Any Night ticket lets you move your visit to a drier night.

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 8:15 AM for breakfast at La Farm by about 8:45 AM.
Koka Booth's page: about 1,500 free parking spaces; preferred parking $10 in advance or $15 the night of the event.
Koka Booth bans outside food and drink except 2 factory-sealed water bottles, plus lawn chairs and pets (service animals allowed).
Eat at SAAP at 4:30 PM to reach Koka Booth for the 6 PM gate opening.
Apex Turkey Trot 5K runs at 10 AM at Apex Community Park, $12-$30 (event cb9cb31e6f2f), if you would rather race than shop.

itineraries.title: Durham Sunday: Orchid Show at Duke Gardens, Art Walk Holiday Market, Jazz Social at 21c, FestiBull of Lights
itineraries.theme: Mostly indoor art, orchids and jazz in downtown Durham, with a light show at the ballpark after dark
itineraries.drive_time: Downtown Durham is about 21 mi (straight line) northwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 30-35 min by car. Duke Gardens is about 1.5 mi from downtown Durham (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Orchid show and Art Walk free; Jazz Social $20; FestiBull $12-$13; about $45-$70 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Sunday has a chance of light rain with a high near 67°F, so this day leans indoors. Breakfast at Elmo's Diner on Ninth Street, then see hundreds of blooming orchids at the Triangle Orchid Society show in Duke Gardens' Doris Duke Center. Lunch at Luna, then shop the Durham Art Walk Holiday Market at indoor and outdoor sites downtown. Hear live jazz at 21c Museum Hotel at 4 PM, eat Ethiopian at Goorsha, and walk through FestiBull of Lights at the Durham Bulls Athletic Park.

morning.title: Triangle Orchid Society Fall for Orchids Show
morning.location: Sarah P. Duke Gardens – Doris Duke Center, 420 Anderson Street, Durham, NC 27708
morning.notes: 10 AM-3 PM, indoors. Displays plus free talks and demonstrations on growing orchids at home. Info: https://gardens.duke.edu/event/triangle-orchid-society-fall-for-orchids-show-2/

afternoon.title: Durham Art Walk Holiday Market
afternoon.location: Downtown Durham (start at Durham Arts Council), 120 Morris Street, Durham, NC
afternoon.notes: 1-5 PM. Regional artists and live music at indoor and outdoor sites downtown. Info: https://triangleonthecheap.com/durham-art-walk-holiday-market/

afternoon.title: Jazz Social
afternoon.location: Main Gallery at 21c Durham, 111 North Corcoran St, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: 4-6 PM. Live jazz among 21c's contemporary art. Book: https://21cmuseumhotels.com/jazz-social-at-21c-durham/ (an Eventbrite listing for the NCCU Jazz Collective show is marked sold out).

evening.title: FestiBull of Lights
evening.location: Durham Bulls Athletic Park, 409 Blackwell St, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: 5:30-9 PM. Tickets required for all guests 3 and up. Tickets: https://cbc-events.com/event/festibull-of-lights/

food.vegetarian_dish: Santa Fe Breakfast Bowl (weekend special): cornbread fritters, mashed sweet potatoes, black beans, chilaquiles sauce, scrambled eggs, feta, avocado
food.notes: 776 9th Street, Durham, NC 27705, near Duke East Campus, about 1.5 mi from Duke Gardens. Own site: Saturday-Sunday 7 AM-3:30 PM; no reservations. Weekend brunch specials for the week of Nov 16-22: Santa Fe Breakfast Bowl $11; Veggie Southwest Grits $9. Vegetarian by listed ingredients (not labeled). No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Camote Chimichurri (GF, V+): chipotle-roasted sweet potatoes, black beans, avocado, sweet corn salsa, chimichurri
food.vegetarian_dish: Vegetarian empanada: quinoa, black beans, sweet corn, pepper jack
food.notes: 112 W Main St, Durham, NC 27701, a few blocks from the Durham Arts Council. Own hours page: open seven days, 11 AM-9 PM. Own menu key: V = vegetarian, V+ = vegan. Camote Chimichurri (GF, V+) $11; Chili Braised Jack Fruit (GF, V+) $16 with two sides; vegetarian empanada $5.50.

food.vegan_dish: Vegan platter of three: e.g. Kik Alecha (yellow split pea stew), Metin Shiro (ground chickpea stew), Fosolia (green beans and carrots in tomato sauce)
food.notes: 910 West Main Street, Durham, NC 27701, about 0.8 mi from the ballpark. Own site: Saturday-Sunday 12-9 PM. Own menu: a vegan platter of three choices (listed at $17; the page also shows 'Vegan Options $14.00' for a choice of three) from Kik Alecha, Gomen, Yemisir Kik, Tekil Gomen, Metin Shiro and Fosolia.

alternatives.leg: Durham Art Walk Holiday Market (indoor and outdoor sites)
alternatives.good_weather: Chance of light rain, high near 67°F.
alternatives.rain: Stick to the indoor sites, starting at the Durham Arts Council, 120 Morris Street.

alternatives.good_weather: Chance of light rain; bring a rain layer.
alternatives.rain: Indoors instead: Chamber Music at Duke: Concert 1 at Baldwin Auditorium, 1336 Campus Dr, 7-8 PM (price not in the store; event e33268478086), or the Bach Cantata Series at Duke Chapel at 5 PM (event 4cf116281749).

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 8:30 AM for breakfast at Elmo's around 9:15 AM.
Route: I-40 west to NC-147 (Durham Freeway) into downtown (route not checked against a routing service).
Suggested evening order: Jazz Social 4-6 PM, dinner at Goorsha about 6 PM, FestiBull from about 7:15 PM.
Parking for Duke Gardens, downtown Durham and the ballpark was not verified.
A second listing covers the Art Walk's 10 AM-5 PM hours (event 75c7ea52c702).

itineraries.title: Pittsboro Sunday: Breakfast at Fearrington, Pittsboro Gallery of Arts, Harvest Festival at The Plant, Pittsboro Tree Lighting
itineraries.theme: A small-town Chatham County day of local art, a harvest market and the downtown tree lighting
itineraries.drive_time: Pittsboro is about 30 mi (straight line) southwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 40-50 min by car. Fearrington Village is north of downtown Pittsboro and The Plant is east of it (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Gallery, Harvest Festival and tree lighting free (the tree lighting's price is not in the store); about $35-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Sunday has a chance of light rain with a high near 67°F. Have breakfast at The Belted Goat in Fearrington Village, then see painter Rita Baldwin and ceramic artist Debbie Englund at the Pittsboro Gallery of Arts. Spend midday at the Harvest Festival at The Plant, which has a craft market, live music and seasonal food and drink. Downtown Pittsboro lights its tree from 3 PM, and Elizabeth's Pizza runs a Sunday veggie-pizza special for dinner.

morning.title: The Works of Rita Baldwin and Debbie Englund
morning.location: Pittsboro Gallery of Arts, 44-A Hillsboro St., Pittsboro, NC 27312
morning.notes: Hours not in the store. Paintings by Rita Baldwin and ceramics by Debbie Englund. Info: https://thetriangleweekender.com/event/the-works-of-rita-baldwin-and-debbie-englund/2026-11-22/

afternoon.title: Harvest Festival
afternoon.location: The Plant, 220 Lorax Lane, Pittsboro, NC 27312
afternoon.notes: 12-6 PM. Craft vendor market, live music, seasonal food and drink, talks and community activities. Info: https://www.theplantnc.com/event-details/harvest-festival

afternoon.title: Pittsboro Tree Lighting Celebration
afternoon.location: Downtown Pittsboro (Hillsboro, Hanks, Fayetteville & Salisbury Streets), Pittsboro, NC 27312
afternoon.notes: 3-6 PM. Price not in the store. Info: https://shoppittsboro.com/holly-days-and-tree-lighting/

evening.title: Dinner at Elizabeth's Pizza (not a stored event)
evening.location: Elizabeth's Pizza, Pittsboro (use the Directions link on its site)
evening.notes: Sunday hours 11 AM-9 PM per its own site. See the food section for the Sunday veggie-pizza special.

food.vegetarian_dish: Veggie Rolled Omelet: mushroom kale ragout, side green salad
food.notes: 210 Market Street, Fearrington Village, Pittsboro, NC 27312. Own page: open Wednesday-Sunday 9 AM-5 PM; breakfast 9-11 AM, lunch 11:30 AM-3 PM; order online or at the counter. Breakfast: Veggie Rolled Omelet $15, Avocado Toast on Seeded Sourdough $17 (with fried egg), Overnight Oats $12. Vegetarian by listed ingredients (not labeled). No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Sunday special Large Veggie Pizza ($19.99), or Vegetarian pasta with tomato, onion, green pepper, mushrooms and eggplant ($15.59)
food.notes: Own site: Sunday 11 AM-9 PM; closed Tuesday. Sunday special: Large Veggie Pizza $19.99. Vegetarian pasta $15.59 (fresh tomato, onion, green pepper, mushrooms and eggplant with garlic and olive oil); pasta dinners come with garden salad and garlic bread. The street address is not in the site's page text; use its Directions link. No vegan dish verified.

alternatives.leg: Harvest Festival at The Plant (mostly outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Chance of light rain, high near 67°F.
alternatives.rain: A meetup listing for the same festival calls it an indoor-outdoor vendor show (event 88a19f4e5fae), so part of it is under cover. Fearrington Village's Festive Floral Workshop (Thanksgiving centerpiece) runs 2-4 PM at 240 Market St (price not in the store; event 8429f2b2a627).

alternatives.good_weather: Chance of light rain; bring a rain layer.
alternatives.rain: Return to the Pittsboro Gallery of Arts, a few blocks away on Hillsboro Street, or head to dinner early.

practical_notes: Suggested departure from Raleigh: 9:00 AM to reach The Belted Goat by about 9:50 AM (breakfast ends at 11 AM).
Route: US-64 west from Raleigh/Cary to Pittsboro (route not checked against a routing service).
Lunch is at the Harvest Festival, which lists seasonal food and drink; no specific vendor or dish was verified.
Parking at Fearrington, The Plant and downtown Pittsboro was not verified.
Tree-lighting info: https://visitpittsboro.com/event/pittsboro-tree-lighting-celebration-2/

itineraries.title: Chapel Hill and Carrboro Tuesday: Weight of Light at Hanes Art Center, NC Botanical Garden, Carrboro Thanksgiving Market, Our Town at PlayMakers
itineraries.theme: A pre-Thanksgiving weekday of campus art, a garden walk, holiday market shopping and Thornton Wilder at PlayMakers
itineraries.drive_time: Chapel Hill is about 25 mi (straight line) west-northwest of downtown Raleigh, roughly 35-45 min by car. All stops are within about 3 mi of each other (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Gallery, garden and market free; Our Town $20-$75; about $45-$70 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Tuesday is mostly sunny and cooler, with a high near 56°F. Start with a breakfast sandwich at Merritt's Grill, then see taylor barnes's 'Weight of Light' at UNC's Hanes Art Center. Lunch at Tandem in Carrboro and walk the NC Botanical Garden (free, open 9-5 Tuesday). The Carrboro Farmers' Market holds its Thanksgiving market 3-5 PM. Dinner at Glasshalfull, then PlayMakers' production of Our Town at 7:30 PM.

morning.title: John and June Allcott Gallery: taylor barnes, Weight of Light
morning.location: Hanes Art Center, 121 E. Cameron Avenue, Chapel Hill, NC
morning.notes: Open 8 AM-5 PM. Seven works made during taylor barnes's residency at West Orchid in Pine Lake, Georgia. Info: https://go.unc.edu/barnes

afternoon.title: NC Botanical Garden display gardens (self-guided; not a stored event)
afternoon.location: North Carolina Botanical Garden, 100 Old Mason Farm Road, Chapel Hill, NC 27517
afternoon.notes: Garden's visit page: display gardens open 9 AM-5 PM Tuesday-Sunday, no ticket or fee, donations welcome. It closes Thursday Nov 26 and Friday Nov 27 for the holiday. The back entrance via Laurel Hill Road is closed to vehicles. https://ncbg.unc.edu/visit/

afternoon.title: Carrboro Farmers' Market Thanksgiving Market
afternoon.location: Carrboro Town Commons, 301 W Main St, Carrboro, NC 27510
afternoon.notes: 3-5 PM. The market's special Tuesday-before-Thanksgiving market. Info: https://www.carrborofarmersmarket.com/visit-us

evening.title: Our Town by Thornton Wilder
evening.location: PlayMakers Repertory Company, 120 Country Club Rd, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
evening.notes: Wilder's Pulitzer Prize-winning play. Info: https://playmakersrep.org/show/our-town/

food.notes: 1009 South Columbia Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27514. Own site: Monday-Saturday 7 AM-4 PM, closed Sunday; breakfast until 10:30 AM. Egg and Cheese $5.59 (vegetarian by listed ingredients). Its lunch menu has a 'Vegetarian Options' section, e.g. the Vegetarian sandwich $8.99 (lettuce, tomato, cucumber, onion, guacamole, balsamic mayo). No vegan dish verified.

itineraries.title: Thanksgiving Day in Raleigh: Trophy Trot 5K at Dix Park, Planes, Trains and Automobiles at Alamo, Irregardless Prix Fixe, Lantern Festival
itineraries.theme: A Thanksgiving Day with no cooking: a morning 5K, a holiday movie, a vegetarian-friendly prix fixe dinner and lanterns at night
itineraries.drive_time: Dix Park, Alamo Drafthouse and Irregardless are all within 2 mi of downtown Raleigh. Alamo (New Bern Ave) to Koka Booth Amphitheatre in Cary is about 10 mi (straight line), roughly 20-25 min by car (estimated from straight-line distance; not checked against a routing service).
itineraries.cost_range: Trophy Trot $35-$50; movie price not in the store; Irregardless $70 per person; lantern festival tickets not in the store
itineraries.overview: The Thanksgiving forecast was not yet published when this was written, so check it the day before. Run (or walk) the Trophy Trot 5K at Dix Park at 9 AM, then catch Alamo Drafthouse's 12:30 PM screening of Planes, Trains and Automobiles. Irregardless serves a $70 three-course prix fixe from 11 AM to 8 PM with several vegan and vegetarian choices; book an afternoon table. End the day at the NC Chinese Lantern Festival in Cary, which has shorter Thanksgiving hours (gates 6-9 PM). Many restaurants close today, including Sitti, Gravy and The Morning Times.

practical_notes: Breakfast and lunch are not named here: Sitti, Gravy and The Morning Times all post that they are closed Thanksgiving Day, and other places' holiday hours were not verified.
Trophy Trot parking: along Maywood Ave in front of Trophy Brewing (from the race listing).
Irregardless's parking page was not checked; the restaurant links a 'Find Parking' page from its site.
Leave Irregardless by about 5:30 PM for Koka Booth's 6 PM gates; Koka Booth lists about 1,500 free parking spaces.
Irregardless also sells a Take & Bake turkey package ($199) with pickup Thursday 8 AM-noon; pre-orders close Sunday Nov 22 at 9 PM or when sold out.
